items.q: And they used to have jam sessions, like the Charleston Bear Cats, they up to the Savoy and all -- Count Basie and they would all have jam sessions and Duke would run all over them.

ctx.x: And Harry Carney, Harry Carney used to play -- he played with me in Boston, see, and they come over here and they made good. Harry Carney and Hardwicke was basic, and who is this trumpet player. Bubber Miley. Duke took all that -- his creation from Bubber. Bubber was a jungle man, played nothing but the jungle. Yeah, growl music and Duke kept that until about '45 and played nothing but his music because no one else was playing his music and in '45 they got together, exchanging music.

And Duke started playing the other people's music. And they used to have jam sessions, like the Charleston Bear Cats, they up to the Savoy and all -- Count Basie and they would all have jam sessions and Duke would run all over them. Duke was a master.
